Sound test-only fix. Binding the rack controller to the explicit 10.0.0.0/8 subnet removes the random-subnet collision described in the commit, and switching the static-IP factory to `subnet=subnet` targets the same subnet deterministically. I verified against the discovery view SQL (`neigh.ip << subnet.cidr` joined on `iface.vlan_id`) that `test_associates_known_subnet` and `test_is_external_dhcp` still exercise the intended path, and `make_Node_with_Interface_on_Subnet` creates exactly one interface per controller (no BMC interface, `with_dhcp_rack_primary/secondary` disabled). One minor robustness note: `rack.current_config.interface_set.first()` relies on `Interface.Meta.ordering = ("created",)` and the implicit single-interface invariant; `rack.get_boot_interface()` is the intended, deterministic accessor since the factory already sets `node.boot_interface`.

src/maasserver/models/tests/test_discove.44: Prefer `rack.get_boot_interface()` over `interface_set.first()`: the factory already sets `node.boot_interface` to exactly this interface, whereas `.first()` depends on the implicit `created` ordering and the single-interface assumption (which the commit message itself flags as fragile).
